item.description:
Ve 0.0.170

  • Workspace invitations work end to end: owners and admins can invite people, see pending invitations, resend or revoke them, and invited people accept or decline from the invitation page.
  • Workspace owners get a switch, off by default, to let people with a company-domain email join the workspace.
  • Sign-in stays active through a laptop sleep and through the moment of signing in, instead of signing you out.
  • Sharing a connection with other members is never allowed; the refusal now says why in plain words.
  • Settings shows what Ve remembers about you and lets you delete one memory or all of them.
  • Suspended or closed accounts and paused workspaces now get a clear explanation at sign-in instead of a generic failure.
  • A sign-in started in one installed copy of Ve is handed back to that copy instead of being lost in another.
  • Ve Code offers one place to connect an AI account when none is connected, and Send explains why it is unavailable while signed out.
  • Setup screens for AI plans and GitHub show your real profile and accounts, and wait for the local agent instead of failing early.
  • Touch ID passkeys for the Ve Vault are not available in this version.
